posts.summary: Questions US AI industry competitiveness, challenges data-center-focused solutions

posts.text:
The first and most consistent feed to warn the US that the American moat in AI would collapse was mine, for nearly three years.

A lot of people, from government to industry to media, should ask themselves why they didn’t listen.
